usedFor: TimeRex holds booked meetings and Zendesk Support holds tickets, so “Event Cancelled” can run “Create Support Ticket” for follow-up.

bestTemplate.name: “Event Cancelled” in TimeRex, then “Create Support Ticket” in Zendesk Support
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation gives your support team a ticket to win the meeting back, with requester and priority settable.

watchOut: “Event Rescheduled” and “New Event” are separate triggers, so each needs its own template to reach “Create Support Ticket”.
